bucket_gold_relevance.definition: How often a same-authority, same-bucket precedent was graded relevant (>=2) by the human grader.

similarity_gold_retrieval.definition: How highly the retrieval ranks a genuinely text-similar same-authority precedent.

interpretation: Precision is strong (top-10 mostly relevant and well ordered), but genuinely similar precedents often rank around 19th, so shallow top-10 lists miss many of them. Next step: tune the rerank weights using these grades as the target.
